assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a transparent two-character modular GAME BODY sprite sheet, exactly TWO sprites side by side with wide separation. Reference1 Tony, reference2 Sean. Crisp chunky SNES pixel art, navy outlines matching references. BOTH figures are AIRBORNE with upright torso, knees bent and both boots tucked backward toward LEFT, leaving lower RIGHT and directly beneath front of torso empty for downward-pointing weapons. Face RIGHT. FULL HEAD, TORSO, BELT, LEGS AND BOOTS but NO ARMS, NO HANDS, NO WEAPONS; clean shoulder attachment area, this is a modular animation layer. Same head/torso proportions as reference, no body rotation, no change of identity. Tony LEFT: dark spiky hair, navy workshirt, teal trousers, brownboots, NO overalls. Sean RIGHT: bald head, chin-only beard, orange shirt, blue overalls, brownboots. Moderate sturdy build. Keep relative head torso leg scales to reference. Each sprite entirely contained in own half. No ground, shadows, labels, grids or background. Genuine transparency. Sprite layer parts, not gore. Body height approx420 source pixels with head and torso same scale as reference first-row body; knees tucked shorten silhouette. Canvas landscape1536x1024.

Use case: stylized-concept. Modular pixel-art ARM PARTS atlas, genuine transparent background. EXACTLY4columns by2rows, eight detached arm sprites, no bodies or weapons. Top row Tony navy rolled sleeve, bottom row Sean orange short sleeve. Each cell one anatomically correct complete arm from shoulder to fist, with upper arm, bent elbow, forearm and gripping hand. Columns in order: 1 NEAR RIGHT trigger arm aimed DOWN-RIGHT45degrees, 2 FAR LEFT support arm aimed DOWN-RIGHT45degrees reaching slightly farther, 3 NEAR RIGHT trigger arm aimed STRAIGHT DOWN, 4 FAR LEFT support arm aimed STRAIGHT DOWN reaching slightly farther. Hand and wrist orientation appropriate for holding downward-aimed tool; near right hand wraps rear pistol grip, far LEFT hand wraps front vertical support grip, thumb opposite the right hand. In all cells shoulder at upper LEFT, arm extends downward (or down-right), elbows natural, hand below shoulder. No raised/upward arms. Both hands must look different-handed, not duplicate right fists. Exact same limb thickness and flesh/outline scale in every cell; forearm about half upper torso height of reference. No enormous fists; fist modestly wider than wrist. Preserve Tony and Sean skin and sleeve colors. Chunky SNES pixels navy outlines, match reference. Every piece fully contained with generous transparent gutters. No reference bodies reproduced, no text, grid, diagram, gore, shadow or background. Wide landscape canvas2048x1024.
